record.interface_detail:
GET https://api.itch.io/wharf/latest

This endpoint does not require authentication.
record.tooling: `butler` CLI (butler push / butler download / butler status) plus the Wharf HTTP API. GET https://api.itch.io/wharf/latest?target=user/game&channel_name=X returns the build manifest. butler does rsync-style block diffing so re-pushes are cheap.
record.chaining: Pushing to a new channel will make a corresponding file appear on your game's page

record.limits_note: Limits: currently, the itch.io backend will reject builds with a total uncompressed size that exceeds 30GB.
record.reliability_note: Pushing the same directory twice is a no-op, so versions accumulate as distinct builds rather than overwriting; butler auth uses an API key, and a project can be taken down by moderation (technical effect: URL 404s, data gone).
record.confidence_note: the 30 GB uncompressed per-build ceiling is stated on the butler pushing page
